chunks: And in another report, he said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said in a lengthy tradition: Our Master will appear, and he is from his loins; and he pointed with his hand to Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him). Thus, he would fill it with justice as it had been filled with injustice and tyranny; and the world would be cleared and prepared for him.

key_terms.تَصْفُو لَهُ: It will be cleared/prepared for him

ai.seo_question: Who is the father of the Mahdi according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from Kitab al-Ghayba, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) explicitly identifies the Mahdi as descending from the lineage of Musa ibn Ja'far (al-Kadhim), a key theological point in Shia eschatology affirming the continuity of Imamate through the Imams. He describes the cosmic transformation where the earth, previously saturated with injustice and tyranny, will be filled with equity by him, resulting in the purification of the world for his just rule.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: Abu Abdullah (a.s) said in a lengthy tradition: Our master will appear from his loins; and he pointed to Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s). Thus, he would fill up the earth with justice and oppression as it would have been filled with injustice and tyranny; and the world would be cleaned and prepared for him.
